title: BAC ends library generation for Illumina sequencing
protocol: Dispatch BAC pool DNA into six aliquots of 5 µg in 150 µL elution buffer.
Perform a first fragmentation on one aliquot using a Covaris g-TUBE device as per manufacturer instructions.
Spin the g-TUBE in an Eppendorf MiniSpin Plus at 9,000 rpm for 60 seconds.
Invert the g-TUBE and spin again using the same speed and duration.
Check the approximate size range by loading 1 µl of a 1:2 DNA dilution on the Bioanalyzer 12000 chip or running a 0.5% agarose gel.
If the size is correct, fragment the next five aliquots and pool them all together.
Reconstitute sheared DNA on two Nucleospin Extract II columns according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Elute the final product from each column with 65 µl NE buffer.
Combine and mix sheared DNA, End Repair Buffer (10x), dNTP mix, ATP, and end repair enzyme in a LoBind tube for each sample.
Gently invert the mixed tube 5 times to ensure thorough mixing.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 20 °C for 1 hour.
Purify the reaction on a Nucleospin Extract II DNA Purification column.
Elute the purified product in 100 µl NE buffer and store it at -20 °C.
Prepare 10X Annealing buffer by mixing Tris, EDTA, NaCl, and water to obtain a final volume of 10 ml.
Resuspend lyophilized adaptor oligonucleotides to achieve a concentration of 250 µM in H<sub>2</sub>O.
In a 0.2 ml tube, mix 5 µl annealing buffer (10X), 10 µl LoxP_Ad1_top (250 µm), and 10 µl LoxP_Ad1_bottom (250 µm).
Add 25 µl H₂O to the mixture.
Prepare a similar mixture using LoxP_Ad2_top and LoxP_Ad2_bottom oligonucleotides.
Anneal the oligonucleotide mixtures in a thermal cycler for 5 min at 95 °C, then decrease temperature by 0.1 °C/sec until reaching 4 °C; hold at 4 °C.
Freeze annealed adaptors in 10 µl aliquots at -20 °C.
To each tube containing repaired DNA, add 15 µl Promega T4 DNA ligase buffer (10X), 3 µl LoxP_Ad1, and 3 µl LoxP_Ad2.
Add 19 µl H₂O to the mixture.
Mix by gently inverting the tube 5 times.
Add 10 µl Promega T4 DNA ligase (final reaction volume = 150 µl).
Mix again by gently inverting the tube 10 times, then spin the tube briefly to collect contents at bottom.
Incubate for 16 hours at 16 °C.
Prepare a 0.5% Megabase agarose gel using 1X TAE buffer (150 ml).
Add 20 µl of 6X loading dye to each 150 µl ligation reaction and load the reactions on two separate large combs.
Load 30 μl of 1 kb DNA step ladder (900 ng ladder + loading dye) into lanes, leaving one empty lane between them.
Run the gel for 4 hours at 85 V.
Stain the gel by incubating it in a diluted SybrGreen bath according to manufacturer instructions.
Examine the gel on a transilluminator to visualize DNA.
Cut gel slices containing DNA fragments ranging from 8 to 9 kb using a clean scalpel blade and the 1 kb DNA step ladder as a size guide.
Purify each collected DNA slice separately using Zymoclean Large Fragment DNA Recovery Kit according to manufacturer instructions.
Elute each purified DNA in 40 µl elution buffer.
Combine elutions from the two matching columns for a total of 80 μl sample.
Run 1 μl of the elution on a Bioanalyzer 12000 LabChip to confirm size and quantify DNA recovery.

Prepare two reactions in 1.5 ml LoBind tubes, each containing 38 µl Size selected DNA, 5 µl ThermoPol buffer (10X), 4 µl PCR nucleotide mix (10 mM each), and 3 µl _Bst_ DNA polymerase, large fragment (8 U/µl).
Mix by gently inverting the tubes 10 times.
Spin briefly to collect reaction contents at the bottom of the tube.
Incubate fill-in reactions for 15 minutes at 50 °C.
Pool two incubated reactions together after incubation.
Purify pooled reaction on a Nucleospin Extract II DNA Purification column.
Elute purified DNA in 50 µl NE buffer.
Remove 1 μl of the sample and dilute it 1/10.
Use 1 μl of the diluted sample for Qubit High Sensitivity quantitation.
Store the remaining sample at -20°C overnight.
Set up 7 circularization reactions, each containing 300 ng DNA.
Prepare a 300 ng aliquot of filled-in DNA in a total volume of 80 µl adjusted with ultrapure water.
Add 10 μl Cre buffer 10X to the reaction mixture.
Add 80 μl size-selected DNA (300 ng) to the reaction mixture.
Add 10 μl Cre recombinase (1 U/µl) to the reaction mixture.
Mix by gently inverting the tubes 10 times.
Spin briefly to collect the contents at the bottom of each tube.
Run the following incubation program: 45 min at 37°C, then 10 min at 70°C.
Prepare a stock of 1 M DTT solution in ultrapure water.
Filter the DTT solution through a 0.45 µm filter.
Store the filtered DTT in single use aliquots at -20°C.
Prepare a fresh DTT solution by mixing 2 μl 1M DTT with 18 μl ultrapure water.
At the end of the 70 °C incubation, add 1.1 µl 0.1 M DTT to each tube.
Gently mix by inverting the tubes 6 times.
Spin briefly to collect the contents at the bottom.
Add 1.1 μl ATP, lithium salt (100 mM) to each tube.
Add 5 μl Plasmid-safe ATP-dependent DNase (10 U/µl) to each tube.
Add 3 µl Exonuclease I (20 U/µl) to each tube.
Gently mix by inverting the tubes 10 times.
Spin briefly to collect the contents at the bottom.
Incubate for 30 min at 37 °C, followed by 10 min at 70 °C.
Add 5 µl EDTA 0.5 M and mix by inverting the tubes.
Split all reactions into two 1.5 ml LoBind tubes.
Purify reactions on a unique Nucleospin Extract II DNA Purification column.
Elute in 24 µl NE buffer.
Proceed immediately to amplification or store at 4 °C.
Combine and mix KAPA HiFi HotStart Ready Mix (2X), pIndigo_F, pIndigo_R, and circularized DNA in a 0.2 ml tube.
Amplify using the PCR cycling conditions: 45 sec at 98 °C, followed by [15 sec at 98 °C, 30 sec at 63 °C, 30 sec at 72 °C] for 20 cycles total, then 7 min at 72 °C, and hold at 4 °C.
Add 50 µL AMPure XP beads to the reaction and mix by short vortexing.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Bind the beads and remove the supernatant.
Add 200 µL 70% ethanol, incubate 30 seconds, and remove.
Repeat ethanol addition once.
Let the pellet dry completely.
Elute in 25 µL elution buffer.
Combine and mix the following components in a 0.2 ml tube: KAPA HiFi HotStart Ready Mix (2X) 25 µl, PCR_2_Illum_F (10 µM) 1 µl, PCR_2_Illum_R (10 µM) 1 µl, First PCR product 23 µl.
Amplify using the following PCR cycling conditions: 45 sec at 98 °C, [15 sec at 98 °C, 30 sec at 64 °C, 30 sec at 72 °C] for 10 cycles total, followed by 7 min at 72 °C, hold at 4 °C.
Clean up the reaction using AMPure XP beads as described at step 8.3. Elute in 25 µL elution buffer.
Remove 1 µl and dilute 1/20 with ultrapure water.
Use 1 µl of diluted sample for Qubit High Sensitivity quantitation.
Load 1 µl of diluted sample on a High Sensitivity DNA LabChip and run on a Bioanalyzer instrument.
Perform four PCR reactions, each using 10 ng DNA from previous PCR as template.
Combine and mix the following components in 0.2 ml tubes: KAPA HiFi HotStart Ready Mix (2X) 25 µl, PCR_3_Illum_F (10 µM) 1 µl, PCR_3_Illum_IndN_R (1 µl), PCR product (10 ng) x µl, H₂O (23-x µl).
Amplify using the following PCR cycling conditions: 45 sec at 98 °C, [15 sec at 98 °C, 30 sec at 60 °C, 30 sec at 72 °C] for 5 cycles total, followed by 7 min at 72 °C, hold at 4 °C.
Pool the four PCR reactions together in a 1.5 ml tube.
Add 200 µl of AMPure XP beads to clean up the pooled reactions.
Elute the cleaned-up product in 25 µL elution buffer.
Measure the concentration of the library using a Qubit fluorometer with the dsDNA HS Assay kit.
Dilute the library to prepare a 1ng/µl solution for quality control.
Load 1 µl of the diluted library on a High Sensitivity DNA LabChip and run on a Bioanalyzer instrument.
Sequence the final QC validated library on a Miseq instrument using 150-bp length paired-end mode (V3 chemistry) to obtain BES 10x coverage.
Dilute the library to 6pM after denaturation for optimal clusterization.
Combine the diluted library with PhiX control spike-in (≥ 20%) before sequencing.
